name: algenta_simulate
description: Run probabilistic Monte Carlo simulations using Algenta. Returns structured recommendations (PROCEED/CAUTION/REJECT/HEDGE) with confidence, expected value, probability of loss, VaR, and percentile distribution. Use this tool when you need to quantify decision risk, model uncertainty in business outcomes, or get data-driven recommendations.

mode.description: Use 'auto' for simple scenarios with variable ranges. Use 'expert' for full probability distribution control.

name.description: Descriptive name for this decision scenario

variables.description: For auto mode: named variables with low/high ranges. E.g.: {"revenue": {"low": 80000, "high": 200000}, "cost": {"low": 40000, "high": 90000}}

runs.description: Number of Monte Carlo scenarios. Higher = more accurate. Default: 50000

simulation_model.description: Simulation engine. monte_carlo is default. Use lhs for better coverage, qmc_sobol for quasi-random, sensitivity for parameter sensitivity analysis.
